messages:
Olivia (CSM): FYI GreenCrest usage cratered after their data lead change. We went from ~10k reqs/day to ~700 yesterday. Procurement said they're running a competitor PoC.
Sanjay (AE): Do we know if it's a technical regression or just churn due to the new team?
Maya (Support Engineer): Ran quick query:
```sql
SELECT date, count(*) FROM inference_events
WHERE account_id='greencrest' AND date >= '2024-04-01'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;
-- last day: 700, 7-day avg: 1.2k, baseline 10.2k
```
Maya (Support Engineer): No 5xxs, no auth failures. Looks like their batch job stopped sending payloads.
Olivia (CSM): New CTO doing a cost and vendor consolidation review. They asked for side-by-side pricing for a small PoC.
Leo (Product): Platform look: no model rollouts or config changes for their org in last 60 days.
Sanjay (AE): I've booked a 30-min sync with CTO + procurement for Fri 9am PT. Olivia, can you prepare a short deck emphasizing cost-to-serve at their scale, and an optional Dedicated trial?
Olivia (CSM): Yes. Proposing: 30-day Dedicated credit + 1-hr onboarding for their ML lead to re-enable pipelines. Low risk for us. Thoughts?
Maya (Support Engineer): Agree — tech session should cover KV cache + batching params and show quick wins. I'll prepare a checklist and a short demo notebook.
ops-bot: Alert: account status set to RENEWAL_RISK. Owner: Olivia (CSM). SLA: 48h follow-up.
Sanjay (AE): I'll export token mix and endpoint usage and DM it to Olivia.
Olivia (CSM): Also would be great to include usage delta graph and a simple math showing Hosted vs Dedicated per-token at their observed throughput. Leo can you draft the cost slide?
Leo (Product): On it. I'll include projected cost curves and a canary rollout plan to avoid traffic cliffs.
Olivia (CSM): Action list: 1) Olivia - one-pager + credit offer; 2) Sanjay - logs & token breakdown; 3) Maya - tech session plan + demo; 4) Leo - cost slide. Re-sync after the Fri call. :thumbsup:
